text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And she's done it! Symboli Rudolf<n>has won her
third crown!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As excited as the commentary is, it's<n>drowned out
entirely by the roar of<n>the crowd. As soon as they
realized<n>this race belonged to the Emperor,<n>there
was no stopping their cheers.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you all for your support. With<n>this win...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The Triple Crown is mine!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
An almost savage roar breaks out as<n>a new Triple
Crown Champion is<n>born.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I did it, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And I must say, it was thrilling to hear<n>such a large
crowd cheering my<n>name.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I went into this race thinking of it as<n>nothing more
than a means to an<n>end...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But the title of Triple Crown<n>Champion... Well, that
does set my<n>heart aflame!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf basks in the cheers<n>for a little while
longer...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Before lifting three fingers skyward.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: But her dream is only getting started!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now that I have claimed the Classic<n>Triple Crown,
it is obvious where I<n>must set my sights next.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The most fitting companion for the<n>honors I
already wear is...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Precisely.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Senior-year students will be taking<n>part.
Competing against them will be<n>a golden
opportunity to demonstrate<n>my prowess.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And besides, if the fans choose me to<n>participate,
that would be an honor in<n>and of itself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even the Arima Kinen is but a<n>stepping stone to
greater glories.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Just as we resolve to fix our sights<n>on the Arima
Kinen...
I'm coming in.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Good work out there, Prez.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Brian. It's not often you come to<n>watch me
race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I was interested in seeing who the<n>strongest
Umamusume was.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
And as expected, it's you. Looks like<n>the Kikuka
Sho was no sweat for the<n>Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I could hardly presume to give you<n>orders if I
wasn't.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to go toe-to-toe with you<n>someday. You
look like an opponent<n>worth sinking my teeth into.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
By all means. I'm confident I can<n>weather a gentle
nibble.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, enough of that. Is Air<n>Groove not with
you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it was egotistical of me to<n>assume that
she would be watching...<n>Or could it be that she
has something<n>to attend to?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You know, probing people isn't really<n>your speed.
You make it too obvious.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's not what I—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Are you worried she won't follow<n>you if you
don't keep an eye on her?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Excuse me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Never mind. Congrats on the Triple<n>Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Get some rest. You've earned it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Of course. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You know, Trainer... About what Brian<n>just said—

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I'm from the newspaper.<n>Do you
have a minute?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Of course. Just give me a moment to<n>get ready.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We can pick this up later. The press is<n>calling.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Between my new rank of Triple<n>Crown Champion
and my future<n>ambitions, I have plenty for them to
get excited about.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the end, however, Symboli Rudolf<n>winds up
swamped with interviews,<n>and we never get the
chance to have<n>that talk.
